title: user.merged
description: Two accounts became one: from_user_id ceased to exist and every record that pointed at it now belongs to into_user_id. Emitted when a guest verifies an authenticator an existing account already holds. Consumers MUST reassign every row they own from from_user_id to into_user_id, idempotently — delivery is at-least-once, and from_user_id is already gone from auth's user table (module FKs cascade, so doing nothing loses the data). into_user_id was announced by its own projection event (user.created/user.updated) ahead of this one.

from_user_id.description: The account that ceased to exist (the anonymous guest); no longer resolvable in auth.

into_user_id.description: The surviving account rows must be reassigned onto.

reason.description: Why the merge happened; "anonymous_promotion" is the only reason auth emits today.
